name: Sejal Glass Limited

verdict_notes: margin fell QoQ and is not up YoY

annual_report.business: Sejal Glass Limited is a leading architectural and specialty glass company serving domestic and international markets with manufacturing facilities in India and UAE.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on fixed assets including capital advances

auditor.name: Gokhale and Sathe
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: 1) Evaluation of Deferred Tax Asset as on 31 March 2026 (Ind AS 12) - Company recognised deferred tax of Rs 903 lakhs in FY 2022-23 on carried forward tax losses, reassessed position as on 31 March 2026 and evaluated derecognition not required. 2) Acquisition of Business Undertaking through Business Transfer Agreement (Ind AS 103, Ind AS 16, Ind AS 38) - acquired business undertakings at Taloja and Erode during the year.

key_risks: Under-utilisation of capacity at newly acquired units (Taloja and Erode) operational only for part of the year
Unabsorbed overheads and lower absorption of fixed operating costs from under-utilisation
Financial and operational performance not entirely comparable with previous year due to significant expansion of manufacturing footprint
Deferred tax asset recognition depends on reasonable certainty of sufficient future taxable income
Integration and ramp-up challenges of newly acquired facilities

latest_guidance.statement: EBITDA margin up about 1 point over coming quarters; PAT margin near 9% in H2 FY27
Fire-rated glass launch Q3 FY27; fire, railway and bullet-resistant glass ~10% of revenue next year
FY27 revenue growth guidance of 25% to 40% year-on-year
FY27 EBITDA margin target around 18% and PAT margin approximately 10%
Expect to reach INR600-650 crores peak revenue from existing infrastructure by FY28
